notes.title: 1.5.1 Update
notes.notes:
Localization

Japanese translation just got a little smoother.

Frostrain is being translated with the help of our users. If you would like to contribute to the translation, please feel free to contact us at the following address! official.frostrain2@gmail.com

We know that many of you are disappointed that your language is not translated. If you'd like to help us translate your language, please let us know. Thank you.

Sincerely, STEWDIO.

notes.title: Developer Letter, and the 1.4 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Frostrain loving conductors around the world! It's been a while, how have you been? It's been almost two months since we announced that we were launching a new update, and a lot has happened. Today we'd like to talk about.

New languages added

We've added new languages! Here are the new languages we've added

- German
- Chinese (Simplified)
- Chinese (Traditional)
- French
- Brazilian Portuguese
- Ukrainian
- Hungarian
- Japanese

We apologize for the long wait and the late update. We had a lot of help from a lot of people, and thanks to them, we were able to make the update happen. Now you can start your journey to the promised land without language barriers!

Usability improvements

We've improved something that many of you have been complaining about.

- You can now skip the "Department of Press" rant at the start of the game. That was a lot of words, we apologize.

Bug fixes

We've also fixed some other minor bugs.

What's next

A lot has happened in the last two months. We tried to add a lot of features, and we even tried to introduce a new system, but the internal structure was much more complicated than we thought it would be, and unfortunately it didn't turn out to be successful.

However, we were too disappointed to give up on the project, so after a series of internal team meetings, we came to one conclusion: let's make a new one.

That's right, we're planning a sequel. We hope to bring you Frostrain 2 with all the exciting elements we originally wanted to include.

Unfortunately, as we've been saying all along, we all have day jobs, so it's going to be a very long development period, but we're going to keep working on it once a week and slowly but surely bring it to you.

We don't know how long this will take, because as you know, there are a lot of variables that come into play during a long development period. It could take two or three years, it could take ten years, or it could even stop halfway through. But we'll work as diligently as we can, because we're as passionate about the game as you are.

Thank you for reading this long post.

STEWDIO Reparations.

notes.title: Restart the update!
notes.notes:
Hello, all you conductors in Frostrain around the world! It's been a while, and we hope you've been doing well. Our development team has been busy with a number of issues. As we mentioned in our last developer letter, some of us have taken on jobs to make ends meet, some have gone back to school to study, and... well... we decided that we couldn't turn a blind eye to the support you've been giving us.

However, we realize that we can't afford to release updates as quickly or as big as we'd like to, so we'll be releasing small comfort updates, balance updates more frequently than in the past, and taking a little longer to release updates with new content whenever possible.

So many of you have been so kind to us, and while we politely declined at first, we felt it would be rude to turn you down any further, so we thought we'd show our appreciation in a small way.

This update includes two announcements and a small balance patch. Thanks!


Major localization announcements.

We've had conductors from Korea, the US, Germany, China, the Czech Republic... and so many other countries enjoy our game, but they've been frustrated by the fact that we only support two languages. We know the difference between a game that supports your native language and one that doesn't - there's a lot of experience lost in the process of "seeing" and "translating".

We released the game on a deadline, so our internal structure wasn't ideal for localization, and that's still the case today, so we're planning to refactor and overhaul the structure so that more people can enjoy the game.

As you know, we're a free-to-play game, so it's hard for us to offer any compensation to those who helped with the translation, but it's almost like you're building the game alongside us, and we'd like to add your name to the credits as a small token of our appreciation for your efforts.

We could use a lot of help. If you're interested, please contact us at the following emails.

devhanghae@gmail.com


Memory issues are not crypto mining

A lot of people have accused our game of being a crypto-mining game. First of all, let me say that Frostrain is not crypto-mined, and that... I... I hate to say this, but it's a problem that was caused by our own lack of competence.

We are aware of the memory issue. My best guess is that it's caused by blizzard effects or exploration nodes. We'll give you the option to turn blizzard effects off and on as a first step, and if you're still experiencing issues... this could be a big systemic fix.

But just to be clear, we're NEVER mining cryptocurrency! Rest assured, you're on your way to the promised land!


Balance adjustment

Since launch, we've held off on balance patches as much as possible. We were worried about drastically changing your experience, but we feel like enough people have enjoyed the game that it's worth tweaking it a bit. We're also worried that we've lost our touch with Frostrain since it's been a while, but we're going to keep a close eye on it and tweak the balance little by little. It's a data-heavy process, and we need your help!

The goal of this balance patch is to make each synergy work more "as intended". To be clear, we're not trying to achieve equal balance - some synergies will be more favorable than others - but they will have different "balance factors": less fun, harder to build combinations, etc.

Fuel and Hammer Brotherhood

The Brotherhood have been a little too... quiet. They've been ridiculously underpowered for a tail section organization, and their base happiness output is so low that even if you have 7 synergy to blow up 10x, it's often not enough. This patch aims to revamp the high-risk-low-reward structure of these brotherhood to make them the high-risk-high-reward they were meant to be.

In addition, we want to make sure that other synergies that are woven into them are indirectly rewarded. For example, entertainment, education, etc.

Job School

Level 1 : Happiness +1. Add +1 if passenger is full. → Happiness +2. Add +1 if passenger is full.

Level 2 : Happiness +2. Add +3 if passenger is full. → Happiness +3. Add +3 if passenger is full.

Level 3 : Happiness +3. Add +4 if passenger is full. → Happiness +5. Add +6 if passenger is full.

Level 4 : Happiness +4. Add +6 if passenger is full. → Happiness +7. Add +10 if passenger is full.

Private Gambling House

Level 1 : Happiness +0~+3 → Happiness +1~+3

Level 2 : Happiness +1~+4 → Happiness +2~+5

Level 3 : Happiness+2~+6 → Happiness+3~+8

Level 4 : Happiness+3~+8 → Happiness+6~+14

Sheriff's Office

Level 1 : Happiness+3 → Happiness+4

Level 2 : Happiness+4 → Happiness+6

Level 3 : Happiness+6 → Happiness+9

Level 4 : Happiness+12 → Happiness+18

Communication Center

Level 1 : Happiness+2 → Happiness+3

Level 2 : Happiness+3 → Happiness+4

Level 3 : Happiness+4 → Happiness+6

Level 4 : Happiness+8 → Happiness+12

Guild of Explorers

Guild of Explorers is a useful synergy to have early on, but I wouldn't call it powerful. We've made its reward more powerful, making it more pleasing to use.

- It now produces more happiness as a reward!

Communication

Communication is an easy synergy to achieve with only 2 car spaces, so we were worried that it might be forced, but since not many people seem to be looking for it, we thought we'd give it a little more... even if it's just a little.

Before : (+4 per train car)

After : (+5 per train car)

Train Power

Train Power has always been the "heart of the train" - it's an essential part of the train, but it's been overpowered, so let's break it down a bit.

Train Power(3) : Improves 300% faster. → 240% faster improvement.

Security

Security was a synergy that really went through the motions. Looking at its abilities alone, it's definitely a backbone synergy that's responsible for the early to mid game, but it's also a tier 4 facility, so it's not easy to get it right. We have a lot of thoughts on how to improve it (within the limits of what we can do), but first, we're going to make it worthy of tier 4 so that it can be used in the late game.

Security(4) : Gain Central Intelligence Agency (+50 Happiness) → Gain Central Intelligence Agency (+72 Happiness).

notes.title: 240128 hotfix
notes.notes:
We've fixed the following errors
- Fixed an error that caused players to return to the same specs as level 1 upon reaching level 4 of the State Press Department.
- Fixed a bug where the tooltip stated that Front Room gained +5 Happiness per car at level 4, when in fact it only gained +3.

notes.title: 240119 hotfix
notes.notes:
We've been overwhelmed by the amount of encouragement and feedback we've received since the developer letter, and we're truly touched by it - thank you!

Fixed the following bugs
- Fixed a bug where clicking very quickly upon entering the character selection scene could make an unlocked character playable.
- Fixed when clears are saved, so if you have a clear, you shouldn't experience a bounce that causes your unlocked character to disappear. We apologise for any inconvenience this may cause.
